name: U-Line® Seamless Collection 24" 5.1 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Refrigerator with Glass Door
shortDescription: Created for both indoor and outdoor spaces that appreciate the fine details, the Seamless 24" Refrigerator brings integrated refrigeration to a higher standard. An adjustable, panel-ready grille aligns with surrounding cabinetry to create a continuous toe-kick, while the panel-ready integrated door can be finished with your own panel and hardware—or elevated with U-Line door wraps and a curated selection of door pulls. Inside, a refined black interior with warm black accents frames 5.1 Cu. Ft. of storage capable of storing up to 150 cans, organized in three full-extension bins with 18-point adjustability. Electronic touch controls provide precise temperature selection from 34°F to 70°F, and multi-point LED lighting in 30 color choices, including BrightShield® antimicrobial protection, allows for even more customization. From weeknight prep to weekend hosting, everything stays perfectly chilled, beautifully organized, and ready on demand. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*
